title: Faculty (Group-A) Posts - Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor
application_fee: Rs. 2360 for General/OBC/EWS, Rs. 1180 for SC/ST, Free for PwBD
age_limit: Max 58 years for Professor/Additional Professor, Max 50 years for Associate Professor/Assistant Professor
summary: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Bathinda invites offline and online applications from eligible candidates for faculty positions (Group-A) including Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor across various departments on a direct recruitment basis. Interested candidates must submit their online Google Form by November 30, 2026, and send the printed hard copy along with required documents by December 3, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Must possess essential educational qualifications and experience as recognized by MCI/NMC/Govt. of India.
Age limit is determined as of 30 November 2026, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per DOPT guidelines.
Valid category certificates (OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwBD) must be in the prescribed Central Government format.
how_to_apply_steps: Fill out the mandatory online Google Form via the official link by 30 November 2026 (05:00 PM IST).
Download the application form from the AIIMS Bathinda website and fill it out in MS Word format.
Pay the applicable application fee online via SBI Collect and retain the transaction receipt.

Send the printed hard copy of the application form along with self-attested supporting documents, fee receipt, and NOC (if employed) via Registered/Speed Post or by hand to the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Bathinda by 03 December 2026.
